Only then may you report a hard limitation to the user — never hallucinate tools that do not exist.

It also requires the system to never hallucinate tools that do not exist.

spans.text: If an operation fails (such as a malformed T3D failing to compile), you MUST independently analyze the compiler output, diagnose the root cause (type mismatch, broken pin link, wrong node class), and execute a correction loop up to three times per failing operation (not per entire project task).
spans.note: The prompt includes multiple safety mechanisms for tool and action execution. It mandates verification before and after modifications, requires compilation checks, enforces a retry-and-fix loop with a maximum of 3 attempts before escalating to the user, warns about high-risk operations, and requires mandatory verification steps before declaring tasks complete. It also requires reading the current state before modifying existing assets.
